caption: Skirmisher-screen subcommander directive (#1467). Team 1's general runs the new 'screening' doctrine, so its subcommander pushes the archer unit out from behind its own heavy blocks to a contest line one ranged reach (8 m) ahead of that line, in the SKIRMISH stance -- watch it hold there and trade fire as the player line walks up. Once the player line closes inside the withdraw trigger (6 m), the same subcommander recalls it: the archers about-face and fall back on a diagonal, aimed at the INTERVAL between the left and middle blocks (the nearer of the two gaps, by 150 wu against 270) rather than straight back through a block, while the heavy line holds its ground instead of breaking to rescue them.
